models.mechanism: Recurring time functions as a press: succession subjects what occurs within it to constraint, making latent contents emerge as a discernible yield.

activation_trace.assigned_role: the repeated temporal medium in which the process operates
the transformative pressure that makes hidden content manifest
the output disclosed by temporal pressure

structural_cues: The revealed text is only the oath phrase والعصر: wāw plus one definite noun.
No verb or result clause states how time acts, so any pressure-to-yield sequence remains latent rather than grammatical assertion.
B002 and B007 share an extraction relation within the sole revealed root.

abductive_moves.assumption: The oath invokes an internal operation of time, not merely neutral duration.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: It coheres the recurring-time, pressing, and extracted-yield branches into one functional process.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: The packet supplies B001, B002, and B007; the reader supplies recurring time -> pressure -> manifested yield.

changed_reading.after: Provisionally: By time as the pressure through which what is latent becomes an extracted yield.

models.ablation: Removing B002 collapses the pressing mechanism; removing B007 leaves pressure without an extracted outcome; removing B001 severs both from the ordinary temporal anchor.

models.mechanism: Time acts as an interval of protective restraint: it holds developing contents within bounds until they reach their proper stage, so delay can preserve rather than merely deprive.

activation_trace.assigned_role: the interval across which development occurs
the restraining action that prevents premature release
the material image of bounded preservation
the developmental threshold toward which restraint tends

structural_cues: The oath names a definite temporal term but supplies no overt agent, patient, or event.
The single noun can denote an age or stage (B001), while B006, B010, and B009 supply dormant restraint, enclosure, and maturation roles under the same root.
No revealed syntax orders those roles into a sequence.

abductive_moves.assumption: Withholding and enclosure are temporarily protective and terminate in maturation.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The packet gives the three states but does not state their purpose or temporal order.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: The packet supplies B006 restraint, B010 enclosure, and B009 maturity; the reader supplies restraint -> preservation -> maturity within B001 time.

changed_reading.after: Provisionally: By time as a bounded interval whose restraint shelters development until its proper stage.

models.ablation: Removing B006 or B010 reduces the reading to generic maturation over time; removing B009 removes the endpoint that makes restraint protective rather than merely restrictive.

surprise_reading: At baseline, العصر may name not only passing time but either a press that extracts what events contain or a protective interval that holds development back until maturity; both readings are provisional.
